example.title: Strand Theatre and neighbouring commercial building, Main Street

brief: A small-town movie house beside a Prairie-School-flavoured brick shop building. The theatre front is two storeys of smooth white glazed terracotta with a recessed panel and dentil cornice, big red channel letters, and a three-sided marquee with red-and-white changeable-letter boards over a glass lobby front with poster cases. Next door: two-storey dark red brick with wide banded windows, a green clay-tile pent roof, a vertical red blade sign and a teal-framed recessed storefront under a flat canopy. Big planters at the curb.
